description: This file defines the EmployeeDecorator class, which provides enhanced methods for handling Employee entity data, such as formatting dates, managing employee attributes, and referencing related entities within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing extended functionality for Employee entity objects, including data formatting, attribute management, and entity referencing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an Employee entity.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the encapsulated Employee entity.

methods.name: getJoinedDate
methods.description: Returns the employee's joined date formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getDrivingLicenseExpiredDate
methods.description: Returns the employee's driving license expiry date formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getBirthday
methods.description: Returns the employee's birthday formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getSmoker
methods.description: Returns whether the employee is a smoker as a boolean.

methods.name: setSmoker
methods.description: Sets the employee's smoker status based on a boolean input.

methods.name: setNationality
methods.description: Sets the employee's nationality reference by ID.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns 'active' or 'terminated' based on the employee's termination record.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the employee's primary Location object if available.

methods.name: setLocationById
methods.description: Sets the employee's location by location ID, replacing existing location if needed.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Assigns a JobTitle entity to the employee by ID.

methods.name: setEmpStatusById
methods.description: Assigns an EmploymentStatus entity to the employee by ID.

methods.name: setJobCategoryById
methods.description: Sets the employee's JobCategory by ID.

methods.name: setSubunitById
methods.description: Sets the employee's Subunit (department) by ID.

methods.name: getFirstAndLastNames
methods.description: Concatenates and returns the employee's first and last names.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the employee's full name including first, middle, and last names.
